hook: Hyderabad had *1,372 lakes*; nearly half are gone, says CM
hook_b: Hyderabad had *1,372 lakes*; nearly half are gone, says CM
tldr: At the Thammidikunta lake inauguration, CM Revanth Reddy tied lost lakes to flooding and said Musi work would start soon.

beats.what: The CM said the first phase of the Musi rejuvenation project would begin shortly and that no one would suffer losses.
beats.why: He said lost water bodies broke natural drainage, leaving roads and colonies prone to flooding.
beats.care: Musi works and lake drives decide which colonies flood less, and which structures face action.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: he said Musi pollution is hurting people downstream in Nalgonda district, and asked all parties to cooperate.

facts.t: Thammidikunta, which had *shrunk to 14 acres*, was expanded to 30 acres, the CM said.
